g.text: The average, and the three evals behind it

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6c78

g.text: One row per model. Large diamonds are the equal-eval mean; small shapes are the individual eval means.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6c78

g.text: Open marks / upper line: 10 minutes. Filled marks / lower line: 30 minutes. Models are ordered by their 30-minute overall mean.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6c78

g.text: Small points show eval averages, not individual trials or uncertainty. Report exclusions and scaffold differences are documented with the data.
